node.statement: Fix W_RF, an admissible input and supplied setting S, and a supplied Delta-prime, and assume 0 <= eta <= rho_Delta. Put D := C_Delta-prime and d := (C_T+D)*eta. Since rho_Delta <= rho_unit and rho_Delta <= rho_Delta-prime, lem-routef-raw-factor-units and lem-routef-delta-prime-closeness give that Delta-prime is CP, ||Delta-prime-tilde-Delta||_cb <= D*eta, and ||tilde-Delta(I)-I|| <= C_T*eta. Hence, for a := Delta-prime(I), positivity of Delta-prime gives a >= 0 and the triangle inequality gives ||a-I|| <= d. Moreover rho_Delta <= [2*(C_T+D)]^(-1), while C_T and D=C_T+4*C_theta are positive by def-routef-raw-factor-setting together with lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation; therefore 0 <= d <= 1/2.
